description: This file defines API endpoints for task management in a FastAPI application. It includes CRUD operations such as listing, retrieving, creating, updating, toggling completion, and deleting tasks. The endpoints are secured and operate on tasks owned by authenticated users, leveraging dependency injection for database sessions, authentication, and service layers.
